children.counts: Use simple 1-2-3-4 counts for the arm circles.
children.game_version: A 'follow the leader' game where children mimic the circular arm motion to music.

seniors.counts: Use a slow 4-count for each full circle.
seniors.seated_version: Perform the arm circles while seated in a chair, focusing on range of motion.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the arm circles while standing with feet shoulder-width apart for stability.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduce tempo to a comfortable pace; keep arm circles within a pain-free range.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Clenched fists held together in front of the body, moving in a horizontal, circular motion.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Hips may be gyrated in sync with arm movements.

signature_moves.description: Horizontal, circular motion of clenched fists in front of the body.
signature_moves.name: Cabbage Patch Motion

basic_steps: Clench fists together in front of the body.
Move fists in a horizontal, circular motion.
Gyrating the hips in sync with the arm movements.
